item.title: The Things I’m Loving This November
item.dc:creator: Margaret Cole
item.content:encoded:
It’s somehow already almost mid-November. My winter arc is officially underway, Thanksgiving is around the corner, and I’m trying to restrain myself from buying all of Target’s holiday decor. As we look towards the rest of the month, here are the things I’ve been loving so far this November:

01A Workout/Class

CycleBar’s 45-minute classic ride

I usually do the 6am class and I leave dripping sweat every time! This class is an amazing blend of cardio and strength training and has become a regular part of my week.

02A Product

Hatch Alarm Clock

If you know me, you know I have a Hatch because I talk about it all the time. This alarm clock is especially useful in the colder months when the sun rises later and later.

03Something I Read

Yesteryear by Caro Claire BurkeLead Like You Were Meant To by Rob McKinnon

Full disclosure, I have not finished either of these books yet, but so far they are both great. Yesteryear is popular right now, and for good reason. Lead Like You Were Meant To is a self help book about unlocking your full leadership potential and thus far, the insights have been unlike any other self help book I’ve read. This book leaves you with a lot to reflect on when it comes to your own actions and the way you influence those around you.

04A Food/Drink

Bagel with peanut butter and Himalayan sea salt on top

This has been my go-to breakfast for the last several weeks and it still hits every morning, especially after a hard workout. The sea salt on top is absolutely essential.

05A DC Spot

Perry’s

This is hands down my favorite restaurant in DC. Perry’s is a Japanese fusion restaurant with all your traditional sushi rolls plus incredible appetizers like their Amazake Focaccia and their Karaage Fried Chicken. The next time you and your friends are deciding where to go for dinner, this should be at the top of your list.

06One Small Habit

Putting on my workout gear first thing after I wake up

One thing I’ve noticed is that the later I wait to put on my workout gear in the morning, the more time I have to convince myself to skip the workout altogether (this has happened a number of times). However, if the first thing I do after I get out of bed is change into a cute set, then I never skip my workout. I didn’t fully commit to this habit until maybe a few weeks ago, but ever since I have, I’ve found that my motivation rarely falters.

I’d love to hear what some of your favorites have been so far this month and who knows, maybe they’ll show up in December’s edition.

What are you loving this month? Tell me on vitalityritual.org, where there’s a box for each category.
